text:
Zoe: PSA: 7:50 ferry was backed up, ended up waiting in the rain. Anyone else stuck?
commute-bot: FERRY ALERT: Pier 2 experiencing boarding delays ~20-35 minutes due to increased passenger flow.
Harper: I ditched it and took the 22 MUNI — felt like a swamp bus though. Shoes officially wet.
Diego: Bridge walkway had those gusty pockets again. Almost lost my umbrella to the wind vortex by the lookout. :umbrella: :dash:
Nina: Office tip: spare microfiber towel on the coat rack by reception. Use liberally.
Zoe: Bless that towel owner. Thinking of making a tiny "commute kit" board in the kitchen with cheap shoe covers and snacks. Thoughts?
Harper: Love it. Label a shelf "rain survivors". :sweat_smile:
Diego: If anyone finds a navy beanie with a bright orange tag, that's mine — victim of gust #2.
commute-bot: MUNI UPDATE: 22 & 33 running 10-15m behind due to signal issues; plan accordingly.
Nina: Quick check 10:30 tea run for soggy commuters? React with :tea: if you want a cuppa.
Zoe: :tea:
Harper: :tea:
Diego: :no_entry_sign: on a sync but appreciate it.
Zoe: Alright team, thanks for the heads-up. Keep an eye on alerts and maybe stash those extra socks.
